name: role-model
description: Stable baseline for the role-model protocol and role-model-router family.

scripts.lint: biome check . && corepack pnpm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path role-model-router/rust/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path role-model-router/rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.schemas:validate: corepack pnpm --filter @role-model/schema-tools exec tsx src/validate-schemas.ts validate
scripts.types:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @role-model/schema-tools exec tsx src/validate-schemas.ts generate-types
scripts.runtime:package-sea: corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-ui build && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge... build && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge run package-sea
scripts.runtime:validate-packaging: corepack pnpm run runtime:package-sea && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge run validate-packaging
scripts.runtime:validate-vendors: corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge exec tsx src/validate-vendors.ts mock
scripts.runtime:test-critical: corepack pnpm run runtime:build-test-deps && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge run test:critical:ci && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-ui run test:critical && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-ui && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-observability
scripts.runtime:test-validators: corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-ui && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-observability && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-tools && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-catalog-economics
scripts.runtime:test-router: corepack pnpm run runtime:build-test-deps && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge run test:router:ci && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/trace test && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/usage test && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-routing && corepack pnpm run runtime:validate-observability
scripts.runtime:test-full: corepack pnpm run runtime:test-critical && corepack pnpm run runtime:test-browser
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run types:generate && corepack pnpm run runtime:build-test-deps && pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=4 --filter=./apps/* --filter=./packages/* --filter=./role-model-router/apps/* --filter=./role-model-router/packages/*
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:workspace && corepack pnpm run test:runtime-host
scripts.smoke: corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/gateway-smoke... run build && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/gateway-smoke exec tsx src/index.ts
scripts.ci:check: corepack pnpm run ci:fast && corepack pnpm run runtime:test-router && corepack pnpm run test:rust && corepack pnpm run smoke
scripts.test:workspace: corepack pnpm run test:release-workflows && pnpm exec turbo run test --concurrency=4 --filter=./apps/* --filter=./packages/* --filter=./role-model-router/apps/* --filter=./role-model-router/packages/* --filter=!@role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge --filter=!@role-model-router/sqlite-memory --filter=!@try-works/pi-role-model --filter=!@try-works/dsh-role-model && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/sqlite-memory test && corepack pnpm --filter @try-works/pi-role-model test && corepack pnpm --filter @try-works/dsh-role-model test
scripts.test:runtime-host: corepack pnpm run runtime:build-test-deps && corepack pnpm --filter @role-model-router/runtime-host-bridge run test:ci
scripts.ci:quality: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run schemas:validate
scripts.ci:build-test: corepack pnpm run ci:build && corepack pnpm run test:workspace
scripts.ci:runtime: corepack pnpm run runtime:test-critical && corepack pnpm run runtime:test-router
scripts.ci:fast: corepack pnpm run ci:quality && corepack pnpm run ci:build-test && corepack pnpm run runtime:test-critical
